title: ESCROW: Guarded and Dual-Objective Continual Maintenance for Agents in Policy-Governed Enterprise Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2608.01772v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly run policy-bound enterprise workflows, where they must apply rules consistently and stay auditable. Deploying such an agent is the start of its long-term maintenance cycle: it must adapt to a stream of operational signals, yet reliably turning these sparse, unlabeled signals into reusable skill revisions is hard, and a careless update can trade one task category's accuracy for the overall gain, revive a resolved failure, or land at an undeployable cost. We present ESCROW, a post-deployment maintenance framework that updates an agent's external, reviewable skills under a Strict Update Boundary: the LLM proposes candidate revisions, but only an empirically evaluated version is deployed. It combines distributed diagnosis with consensus, a per-category non-regression guard, cross-cycle anti-regression, and accuracy--cost Pareto search, emitting a versioned, auditable diff per change. translated_title: ESCROW：面向策略治理型企业工作流中智能体的带防护双目标持续维护框架
translated_abstract: LLM 智能体越来越多地在受策略约束的企业工作流中运行，它们必须一致地应用规则并保持可审计性。部署这样的智能体只是其长期维护周期的开始：它需要适应源源不断的运营信号，然而将这些稀疏且无标签的信号可靠地转化为可复用的技能修订十分困难——一次草率的更新可能会以牺牲某一任务类别的准确性来换取整体收益、复活已被解决的故障，或导致成本高到无法部署。我们提出 ESCROW，一个部署后维护框架，它在“严格更新边界”下更新智能体外部的、可审查的技能：LLM 负责提出候选修订，但只有经过实证评估的版本才会被部署。该框架结合了带共识机制的分布式诊断、按类别的非回归防护、跨周期的反回归机制，以及准确性—成本帕累托搜索，并为每次变更输出带版本的、可审计的 diff。在我们系统的真实生产环境中……
tldr: ESCROW 是一个部署后维护框架，在“严格更新边界”下让 LLM 仅提出候选修订、只部署经实证评估的版本，并通过分布式共识诊断、按类别与跨周期的双重防回归防护以及准确性—成本帕累托搜索，实现策略治理型企业工作流中 LLM 智能体的可审计双目标持续维护。
en_tdlr: ESCROW is a post-deployment maintenance framework that deploys only empirically evaluated skill revisions under a Strict Update Boundary, combining consensus-based distributed diagnosis, per-category and cross-cycle non-regression guards, and accuracy-cost Pareto search for auditable dual-objective continual maintenance of LLM agents in policy-governed enterprise workflows.
